headers.//: The audio never changes in place — README says replace by name or edit MEDIA — so it can be cached hard. Without this every visit made a conditional round-trip per 9 MB file before playback could start.
Font files are content-stable; a new cut would arrive under a new name.
Icons and the link-preview image might get refreshed, so a week rather than immutable — long enough to matter, short enough that a redraw lands without renaming.
index.html, sw.js and the manifest must stay revalidated or a stale shell outlives its update. Vercel's default already does this; stated here so nobody widens the rules above by accident.
